name: kubernetes-mcp
description: FastMCP 3.4.4+ server and React companion webapp for Kubernetes cluster orchestration and Minikube automation
author: sandraschi

tools.name: k8s_node_list
tools.description: List cluster nodes with health, capacity, and resource statistics.

tools.name: k8s_cluster_health
tools.description: Check connection status and active context details of the cluster.

tools.name: k8s_pod_list
tools.description: List pods in a specific namespace.

tools.name: k8s_pod_logs
tools.description: Fetch stdout/stderr logs from a pod container.

tools.name: k8s_pod_describe
tools.description: Describe a pod in detail, combining specifications and recent events.

tools.name: k8s_rollout_restart
tools.description: Trigger a rolling update rollout restart for a Deployment.

tools.name: k8s_apply_yaml
tools.description: Apply a YAML configuration string to create or update cluster resources.

tools.name: k8s_ingress_list
tools.description: List ingress routing rules in a namespace.

tools.name: minikube_status
tools.description: Check status of Minikube running states, VMs, and context name.

tools.name: minikube_control
tools.description: Control local Minikube cluster lifecycle (start or stop).
